'''Gruuvan ''shaal'''''<ref name="ROB">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=Raid on Brentaal}}</ref> was a traditional [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] comprised of seasoned [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] meat, [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]], and [[Flower/Legends|flowers]] served on a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] skewer.<ref name="SWG" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] crewmembers of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' used the name of the dish as a passphrase to make contact with a Rebel [[Tynial|agent]] in the [[Pathline Tapcafe]], an establishment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].<ref name="ROB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gruuvan ''shaal'' was first mentioned in "[[Raid on Brentaal]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure included in ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', a campaign book written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] and published in [[1998]] as part of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ROB" /> The dish later made its first appearance as a craftable item, albeit missing its italics as "Gruuvan Shaal," in the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> which closed in [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, when the player consumed Gruuvan ''shaal'', they received boosted health and health regeneration attributes.<ref name="SWG" />
